name: recon_resupply
description: Section 5.1 worked instance — MILP with binding fuel/aircrew constraints.
question: We have 4 ISR airframe-days; each recon sortie uses one. Resupply burns 2 fuel pallets each and we have 12. Aircrew duty hours total 18; recon needs 3 hours, resupply 2. Each recon sortie is worth 3, each resupply 5. How many of each should we fly to maximize value?
